coverage: Count eligible starts before fallible preceding work. Skipped starts are fallback. Report each head and overall; continued options never add direct starts. Deterministic dead/channel/urgent-win guards reported separately. A target is not evidence of achieved coverage.

commitments: role/strategy/objective explicit option identity; close on replacement, death, channel, fallback or deadline. Records with missing closure or interruption are ineligible for actor training. Physical/save/hold decisions last one turn.
